plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-11 from the official Southern Utah University 2026-2027 General Catalog (current edition, catoid=28) Biology - Biomedical Science Emphasis program page and its linked official degree map, 'Biology & Biology Education Degree Maps (2026-2027)', 'Biomedical Science (Campus)' tab, last updated/reviewed July 27, 2026. Semester placement is the university's official sample 4-year campus academic plan (SUU Program Maps, 2026-2027), which the source itself labels a guide only; students confirm specifics in Degree Works with a Student Success Advisor. Collected as the BS: the catalog prints separate totals (Total Credits, BA Degree: 122-125; Total Credits, BS Degree: 120) and the map expressly states that students electing the BA take 16 credits of one foreign language, which are not included in the map; the map matches the printed BS total of 120 exactly. Every term's courses sum to the map's printed term total (14/14/15/16/15/16/16/14) and the plan to 120. DISCLOSED CATALOG HEADER ERROR: the catalog prints the Biomedical Science Curriculum as 78-81 credits, but its own sub-blocks sum to 82-85 (Core Requirements 22-23 + Biomedical Science Emphasis Courses 56-58 + Biology Requirements (4000-Level) 3 + Seminar/Workshop Requirement 1); the 4-credit difference is exactly the 4000-level and seminar requirements, which the catalog lists under the Curriculum heading. The plan is recorded at the catalog's printed BS degree total of 120, which the official map matches exactly, with the header error disclosed here rather than reconciled (Rotor-Wing header-error precedent; this differs from the held SUU cases, where the map itself or the catalog degree total failed to reconcile). The map exercises the catalog's low-credit options: BIOL 3340 Introduction to Epidemiology (3 credits) for the Core's Complete One of the Following (instead of the Ecology lecture/lab pairing, 4 credits), so the map's Core totals 22, and MATH 1190 Introduction to Data Science (3 credits) for the Quantitative Requirements' complete-one (instead of MATH 1040, 4 credits). The map's three generic 4-credit 3000-level lecture/lab slots total 12 credits, inside the catalog's Biomedical Electives block (complete 11-12 credits; the catalog's elective list is carried on the slots). The map includes INFO 1010 Information Literacy (1 credit), which is not named in the catalog curriculum, and its (%) note states that students who complete the Anatomy and/or Physiology requirements with BIOL 3000-level courses earn 8 credits of upper-division not reflected on the plan and can substitute 8 free upper-division electives with any level; that note is carried on the upper-division free-elective slots. Per the catalog, all courses must be passed with a C (2.0) or better to count in the major, the ETS major field test in Biology must be completed after BIOL 3110 and before any capstone course, courses may not be repeated more than two times without instructor approval, and credits over 10 years old may not be accepted for use in the major. Catalog titles are recorded where the map shortens them.
